scope: Structural design audit only; never substitutes for frozen strong-model calibration

anchor_design.definition: The same cricket-law core instantiated at all five levels while retrieval, authority, temporal and proof burdens vary
anchor_design.pilot20_recommendation: At least five anchor families spanning all levels; retain heterogeneous natural scenarios as a separate ecological-validity track

interpretation_rules: A blocked expansion audit does not invalidate the factual correctness of the current pilot.
Transition diversity prevents one fixed burden from defining an adjacent level across every match.
Cross-level anchors reduce scenario-composition confounding; they do not replace natural scenario breadth.
Only valid strong-model Sentinel5 and Pilot20 runs may calibrate empirical difficulty.
